한국어 English
The Korea Cooperative of Care Robots(KCCR) is hosting the International Care
Robot Conference & Exhibition to share the latest research achievements and
technological trends in the care robotics sector—a key technology for aged
societies. The main event, featuring presentations and exhibitions, will be held on
November 26, while industrial tours and B2B meetings are scheduled for November
25 and 27.
Main Topics
Physical Care
• Mobility & Transfer Assistance
• Wearable Power Assist Devices & Exoskeletons
• Feeding & Domestic Care Support
• Bathing & Toileting Care Assistance
• Pressure Sore Prevention & Postural Repositioning
• Smart Monitoring & Remote Care Systems
• Upper & Lower Limb Rehabilitation Robots
• Occupational Therapy Robots
• Safety, Ethics, and Certification for Care Robots
Mental, Cognitive Care & AI
• Social & Emotional Support Companion Robots
• Cognitive Rehabilitation Robotics for MCI & Dementia Care
• AI-Based Care Robots & Personalised Care Systems
• Social Robots & Human-Robot Interaction (HRI)
• Pediatric Care Robotics & Developmental Disability Support
• Nursing Support & IoT-Based Care Systems
• Autonomous Driving Robots for Hospitals & Care Facilities
• Fall Prevention & Emergency Response Systems
• Caregiver Support & Care Burden Reduction
Submissions are not limited to the topics listed above; innovative presentations and
exhibits related to care robotics are highly welcome.
